title: Shuwa
description: A traditional dish from Oman, centered on lamb, garlic, lemon juice, banana leaf. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Omani shuwa-inspired oven-roasted lamb wrapped in banana leaves; traditional underground pit cooking is not reproduced.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 180 minutes.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Wrap the lamb in banana leaves and foil, set in a covered roasting tray and slow-cook in the oven until tender; do not attempt an improvised underground pit.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
